text:
Type: small textured flatwoven rug
Use: covering a small floor spot, beside a bed or at a door; bedroom, hallway, entryway, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, minimalist
Materials: chunky handwoven yarn flatweave
Colors: mottled mid grey, black, off-white flecks
Shape: rectangular, flat, nubby speckled weave with a subtle diagonal texture, plain edges, compact
Feel: cozy, natural, earthy, understated
Goes with: light wood, white walls, wool and linen textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or rustic rooms

product.name: BASNS
product.description: The durable, soil-resistant wool surface makes this rug perfect for high traffic areas like hallways in your home.
